2126347119699149227.en_summary: Market leadership has shifted: Apple, $AAPL, has outperformed Nvidia, $NVDA, by 30.2 percentage points so far in November, putting it on track for its largest monthly outperformance since the 2008 Financial Crisis. This comes as $NVDA is down -27.0% over this period, while $AAPL is up +3.2% and is trading near its all-time high. This would also mark the 4th-largest monthly outperformance by Apple since Nvidia's IPO in January 1999. Since October 1st, $AAPL has outperformed $NVDA by 44.1 percentage points, putting it on track for its largest 2-month outperformance since July 2011. $AAPL is also on pace to finish higher in 7 of the last 8 months and is up +31.3% year-to-date. Apple has quietly become one of the biggest beneficiaries of the recent market rotation.
2126347119699149227.zh_summary: 市場領導力已經轉移：蘋果 $AAPL 在 11 月迄今已領先輝達 $NVDA 30.2 個百分點，使其有望實現自 2008 年金融危機以來最大的月度超額表現。這是因為 $NVDA 在此期間下跌了 -27.0%，而 $AAPL 上漲了 +3.2%，並接近其歷史高點交易。這也將標誌著自 1999 年 1 月 Nvidia IPO 以來蘋果的第 4 大月度超額表現。自 10 月 1 日以來，$AAPL 已領先 $NVDA 44.1 個百分點，使其有望實現自 2011 年 7 月以來最大的 2 個月超額表現。$AAPL 也有望在過去 8 個月中的 7 個月收高，並且年迄今上漲了 +31.3%。蘋果已經悄悄成為最近市場輪動的最大受益者之一。
